title: ZnoteX 2.0.3
summary: Admin permissions, payments hardening, self-updates and developer tooling.
description: This release adds role-based admin permissions with audit logging, hardens purchases and payment webhooks, replaces jQuery with vanilla JS, modernizes website password verification without touching game authentication, adds a configurable cache, a signed self-update system with automatic backup and rollback, Composer autoloading, PHPStan static analysis, and a stable API contract for plugins and themes.
highlights: Role-based admin permissions with audit logging for sensitive actions.
Purchases, payment webhooks and payment history are hardened against abuse.
Website password verification was modernized without touching game authentication.
jQuery was replaced with vanilla JS across the admin panel and public pages.
A configurable cache backend can be chosen from the admin panel.
Core updates can be checked, verified and installed directly from GitHub, with automatic backup and one-click rollback.
Plugins and themes declare their ZnoteX, PHP and API compatibility through a stable extension API.
CSRF protection was added to public forms.
SCEditor was enhanced with a Quote button and draft autosave.
warnings: Back up the website and database independently before every production update.
